title: Emergency Hub
subtitle: Instant access to verified Indian emergency helplines, guided reporting & trusted resources.
cyberCrimeDesc: Report online fraud, scams, UPI fraud, phishing & cybercrime
womenSafetyDesc: Women emergency & safety support, harassment, stalking
childHelplineDesc: Child abuse, online grooming, exploitation, POCSO cases
policeEmergencyDesc: National emergency number for immediate police assistance
noEmergencyAlerts: No emergency alerts have been triggered recently.
step1Desc: Determine the type of cyber crime — fraud, hacking, identity theft, harassment, or financial scam.
step2Desc: Save screenshots, transaction records, messages, emails, and any other proof related to the incident.
step3Desc: Call the Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 or visit cybercrime.gov.in to file your complaint officially.
step4Desc: Use your complaint reference number to track status on the portal or follow up via the helpline.
dontWait: Don't wait — call the helpline or file a complaint now.
footer: All helpline numbers listed are Government of India official helplines. No personal data is stored without your consent. CyberShield is a privacy-first platform.
